TIL Aerosmith made more money from Guitar Hero than from any of their albums.

TIL in Germany, they have something called a frauenparkplatz, parking spots dedicated to women, closer to exists, in areas with more surveillance and better lighting for safety. They are also sometimes wider.
TIL- Deep-fryer and turkey-fryer fires in US cause an average of 5 deaths, 60 injuries, the destruction of 900 homes, and over $15 million in property damage each year.
TIL about the "final parsec problem": when two galaxies merge, their central black holes should stall roughly 3 light-years apart, but somehow they don't, and astronomers still debate why.

TIL The Code of the U.S. Fighting Force is a code of conduct that is an ethics guide consisting of six articles to members of the United States Armed Forces, addressing how they should act in combat and when they must evade capture, resist while a prisoner or escape from the enemy.

TIL that George Romero's original script for Day of the Dead (1985) was a much larger, more epic film, which he compared to "the Gone with the Wind of zombie films." However, arguments over the film's rating cause the budget to be cut in half, forcing Romero to drastically scale it down.
TIL studies have found monkeys also experience noticeable discomfort when presented with an uncanny valley approximation of monkeys.

TIL that Oymyakon, Siberia, is the coldest permanently inhabited place on Earth. Winter temperatures average around −50°C (−58°F) and have dropped to nearly −68°C (−90°F). Schools only close when it falls below roughly −55°C (−67°F)—and an electronic thermometer reportedly burst at −62°C (−80°F).
TIL that only one woman has ever received the Medal of Honor, Dr. Mary Walker for treating patients in battle and across enemy lines during the Civil War.

TIL during the Protestant Reformation, Martin Luther developed the story of Christkind or Christ Child to discourage devotion to saints like St Nicholas. However, centuries later, the figure became popular in Catholic Central Europe.
